<!-- Supp: Agents track. System-level pattern, not model-specific. -->

::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
**RAG** augments a generative model with a retrieval step: at inference time, relevant documents
are fetched from an external store and prepended to the context. The model's weights remain fixed;
knowledge lives in the retrieval index, not the parameters.
:::

**Depends on:** [Agent Architectures Overview](00_overview.qmd)
